subject.title: feat(usage): show the account email with plan windows in the chat context popover

question: Should provider usage expose account email through the plugin and gateway contracts, and may Claude use a home-wide CLI email when it cannot be tied to the credential that fetched the quota?
rationale: The patch creates a new cross-plugin identity contract and intentionally permits a potentially mismatched account label, so code review cannot choose the permanent privacy and accuracy policy without owner intent.

options.title: Require credential-bound identity
options.body: Approve the feature only when each email is derived from or carried with the exact selected credential, omitting the Claude label when that binding is unavailable.

options.title: Accept best-effort Claude identity
options.body: Approve the home-wide Claude fallback and explicitly own the documented multi-account mislabeling and privacy tradeoff.

options.title: Pause the API expansion
options.body: Keep quota windows account-neutral until a broader provider account-identity contract is designed and approved.

recommendation.title: Require credential-bound identity
recommendation.body: Approve the feature only when each email is derived from or carried with the exact selected credential, omitting the Claude label when that binding is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of the related local Codex and Claude chat workflow makes this the best available routing candidate for the product decision.
